pageState.description: Read the current X route, login gate, challenge, rate-limit, and hydration state.

searchState.description: Verify the active X search route, selected tab, and hydrated results. filter is top, latest, people, media, or lists. Login, challenge, consent, rate-limit, query mismatch, filter mismatch, and unhydrated states are not empty results.

filter.description: Expected tab: top, latest, people, media, or lists.

returns.description: Search route, query, gate, and result state.

searchResults.description: Collect visible X post search results across lazy-scroll pages up to limit.

viewport_only.description: Only include posts intersecting the viewport.

searchPeople.description: Collect visible account rows in the primary column of an X People search, up to limit.

viewport_only.description: Only include rows intersecting the viewport.

searchMedia.description: Collect visible photo and video tiles in the primary column of an X Media search, up to limit.

viewport_only.description: Only include tiles intersecting the viewport.

searchLists.description: Collect visible list rows in the primary column of an X Lists search, up to limit. Each row's destination is read from the control that navigates to /i/lists/<id>.

viewport_only.description: Only include rows intersecting the viewport.

scrollResults.description: Scroll an X search surface by one bounded viewport step.

nudge_up.description: Scroll slightly upward instead of down.

profileDetail.description: Extract the active X profile identity, selected timeline tab, biography, and visible counts.

returns.description: Visible X profile details or an explicit gate state.

profilePosts.description: Collect posts across the active X profile timeline up to limit.

viewport_only.description: Only include posts intersecting the viewport.

scrollPosts.description: Scroll an X profile timeline by one bounded viewport step.

nudge_up.description: Scroll slightly upward instead of down.

postDetail.description: Extract the active X post, author, text, media, publication time, and visible metrics.

returns.description: Visible X post details or an explicit gate state.

comments.description: Collect visible replies on the active X post up to limit; never replies, likes, reposts, follows, or submits anything.

scrollComments.description: Scroll the active X conversation by one bounded step to hydrate more replies.

replyEditorTarget.description: Inspect the verified active conversation and return owned pointer geometry for its single visible reply editor; never focuses or types.

returns.description: Fail-closed reply editor geometry bound to the active post.

replyDraftState.description: Read the draft and focus state of the verified active post reply editor.

returns.description: Current reply draft state bound to the active post.

likeTarget.description: Inspect the active post's own Like control and return owned pointer geometry. Never clicks. liked is true when the control is already the Unlike button.

returns.description: Fail-closed Like control geometry bound to the active post.

followTarget.description: Inspect the profile header Follow control for the requested username and return owned pointer geometry. Ignores Follow buttons inside account suggestion cells. Never clicks.

returns.description: Fail-closed Follow control geometry bound to the active profile.

replySubmitTarget.description: Inspect the verified composer and return owned pointer geometry for its enabled Reply control; never clicks.

returns.description: Fail-closed Reply control geometry bound to the active composer.

renderedReplyState.description: Verify an exact rendered reply by the signed-in account inside the active conversation.

returns.description: Exact signed-in-author reply count and ids for reconciliation.

timelineState.description: Report whether the current X page is a home, search, or profile timeline rather than a post permalink.

returns.description: Timeline surface, path, and gate state.

feedState.description: Verify the X home timeline and its selected tab. tab is the visible label, such as For you or Following. Login, challenge, rate-limit, a missing tab, and an unhydrated timeline are not empty results.

tab.description: Expected home tab label. For you is the usual default. Other labels must be visible on the account.

returns.description: Selected home tab and hydrated post count.

feedTabTarget.description: Return owned pointer geometry for one visible X home tab. Never clicks.

tab.description: Home tab label, such as For you, Following, or another visible tab.

feedPosts.description: Collect visible posts in the X home timeline up to limit.

viewport_only.description: Only include posts intersecting the viewport.

streamReplyTarget.description: Inspect the reply icon on one post already visible in the home, search, or profile timeline. Never clicks and never opens the post URL.

post_id.description: Status id of the timeline post.

returns.description: Fail-closed reply-icon geometry bound to that timeline post.

overlayReplyEditorTarget.description: Inspect the single visible reply overlay composer for the timeline post that was just opened. Never focuses or types.

username.description: Author username of the timeline post.

text.description: Visible text of the timeline post.

published_at.description: Publication time of the timeline post.

overlayReplyDraftState.description: Read the draft and focus state of the visible reply overlay editor.

username.description: Author username of the timeline post.

text.description: Visible text of the timeline post.

published_at.description: Publication time of the timeline post.

overlayReplySubmitTarget.description: Inspect the Reply button inside the visible reply overlay. Never clicks.

username.description: Author username of the timeline post.

text.description: Visible text of the timeline post.

published_at.description: Publication time of the timeline post.

overlayCloseTarget.description: Inspect the close control of the visible reply overlay. Never clicks.

overlayClosed.description: Report whether the reply overlay is gone and the page has returned to the timeline path it started on.

path.description: Pathname of the timeline page before the overlay opened.

returns.description: Overlay dismissal and timeline return state.

streamNameTarget.description: Inspect a person's name link in the current home, search, or profile timeline. Never moves the pointer.

hoverCardState.description: Read the visible hover card for one username, including bio, counts, and whether the account is already followed. Never clicks.

hoverFollowTarget.description: Inspect the Follow control inside the visible hover card for one username. Never clicks.

hoverDismissTarget.description: Return a pointer position on the Home navigation link, away from profile names, so a hover card can close. Never moves the pointer.

returns.description: Pointer position that dismisses a hover card.

hoverCardPresence.description: Report whether a visible profile hover card is open.

returns.description: Hover card open or closed state.
